sect1.title: glslc originário de shaderc-&shaderc-version;

sect2.title: Instalao do glslc
sect2.para: Primeiro, permita construir com e do sistema:

screen.userinput:
sed '/build-version/d' -i glslc/CMakeLists.txt && sed '/third_party/d' -i CMakeLists.txt && sed 's|SPIRV|glslang/&|' -i libshaderc_util/src/compiler.cc &&
echo '"&shaderc-version;"' > glslc/src/build-version.inc

sect2.para: Agora instale glslc executando os seguintes comandos:

screen.userinput:
mkdir build && cd build &&
cmake -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \ -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \ -D SHADERC_SKIP_TESTS=ON \ -G Ninja .. ninja

listitem.para: compila sombreadores OpenGL Shading Language/High Level Shading Language (GLSL/HLSL) para SPIR-V
